title: oenanthe dielsii var. stenophylla
intro: Oenanthe dielsii var. stenophylla, commonly known as Chinese water crowfoot or water celery, is a plant species within the family Apiaceae. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine, and research has highlighted its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Oenanthe dielsii var. stenophylla include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and act as an anticoagulant, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified as responsible for its therapeutic effects.
